input.title: [iOS] Side scroll on the toolbar stop working when user holds menu button too long when trying to side scroll the toolbar
input.body:
## Step to reproduce
1. Create some thought
2. Tap on any blank area to dismiss selection
3. Tap and hold the Toolbar then swipe left or right

## Current behavior
Nothing happens. Toolbar is not scrolled.
Note: This happens on IOS app and Safari mobile on IOS device
Workaround: User needs to quickly tap and scroll to do swipe scrolling, if the tap on the menu button >0.5s will make the scrolling stop working.

**Video:**

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/8a250936-cea8-40ad-a06f-061d44e15aac

## Expected behavior
Toolbar should be scrolled to user's scrolling direction
